salk.definition: n. United States virologist who developed the Salk vaccine that is injected against poliomyelitis (born 1914)

salk vaccine.translation: [医] 索耳克氏疫苗(预防脊髓灰质炎的灭活疫苗)

salkowski's methods.translation: [医] 萨尔科夫斯基氏法(检嘌呤体及尿酸)

salkowski's test.translation: [医] 萨尔科夫斯基氏试验(检血一氧化碳、胆甾醇、吲哚、葡萄糖、肌酸酐)

salkowski-autenrieth-barth's methods.translation: [医] 萨-奥-巴三氏法(检草酸)

salkowski-ludwig test.translation: [医] 萨-路二氏试验(检尿酸)
